title: Revalidate projects after session readiness preflight
outcome: Single-session creation clones a project, releases the state mutex, runs agent readiness and other preflight work, then reacquires the mutex and creates a session using the stale clone without confirming the project still exists. A concurrent project deletion can finish its detach sweep during that window, after which creation persists a session referencing the deleted project. Re-resolve the project under the creation lock, use current locked fields, and add a deterministic deletion-during-preflight regression without moving filesystem probes under the mutex.
